# Semantic Gaussian Prior Training

The fixed protocol is:

```text
nuScenes LiDAR/camera geometry pretraining
  -> best.pt
R3LIVE full-optimization Teacher distillation
  -> best.pt
TorchScript export
  -> r3live_distilled.ts
R3LIVE leave-one-sequence-out evaluation
```

## Input contracts

Every `.npz` shard contains:

- `input`: float32 `[N,24]` (`base_v3`) or `[N,38]` (`context_v4`)
- `target`: float32 `[N,14]`
- `weight`: float32 `[N]`
- `source`: scalar string, `nuscenes` or `r3live_teacher`
- `sequence`: scalar string
- `split`: scalar string for nuScenes; R3LIVE split is overridden by the fold

The first 24 inputs exactly match the legacy online C++ order:

```text
tanh(xyz / 50), RGB, log1p(depth), object_latent[16], confidence
```

`context_v4` appends 14 bounded source-frame and candidate-map features:

```text
normalized pixel u/v,
RGB Sobel gx/gy/magnitude,
relative depth Sobel gx/gy/magnitude,
appearance/depth/geometry/pose reliability,
uncovered fraction,
tanh(log1p(nearest-candidate spacing / initial scale))
```

The manifest, checkpoint, exported TorchScript metadata, and Teacher sidecar
record `base_v3` or `context_v4`. A 24D checkpoint can initialize a 38D model:
the first 24 columns are copied and the 14 new columns start at exactly zero.
Use `--context-adapter-only` to freeze all v3 parameters and train only those
14 new columns; the trainer restores the original 24 columns after every
optimizer step so decoupled AdamW weight decay cannot move them.
Use repeated `--zero-input-feature FEATURE_NAME` options for controlled
feature ablations. The fixed v4 runner also trains:

- `context_adapter_fast`: exact candidate spacing is zeroed.
- `context_adapter_lightweight`: RGB/depth gradients and spacing are zeroed.

The 14 targets are:

```text
mean residual[3], log-scale residual[3], quaternion[4],
RGB residual[3], opacity-logit residual[1]
```

## Commands

```bash
python scripts/prepare_nuscenes_prior_shards.py \
  --dataroot /root/autodl-fs/datasets/nuscenes \
  --version v1.0-mini \
  --output /root/autodl-fs/datasets/nuscenes/prior_shards

python scripts/prepare_r3live_cross_sequence_split.py \
  --bag-root /root/autodl-tmp/datasets/r3live \
  --output data/r3live_folds.json

python scripts/build_prior_manifest.py \
  --shard-root data/prior_shards \
  --r3live-fold data/r3live_folds.json \
  --fold-name test_hku_campus_seq_00 \
  --output data/fold_hku_campus_seq_00/manifest.json

python scripts/train_semantic_gaussian_prior.py \
  --manifest data/fold_hku_campus_seq_00/manifest.json \
  --stage nuscenes_pretrain \
  --epochs 30 \
  --output checkpoints/nuscenes

python scripts/train_semantic_gaussian_prior.py \
  --manifest data/fold_hku_campus_seq_00/manifest.json \
  --stage r3live_distill \
  --init-checkpoint checkpoints/nuscenes/best.pt \
  --learning-rate 0.001 \
  --epochs 12 \
  --decoded-residual-targets \
  --output checkpoints/r3live

python scripts/export_semantic_gaussian_prior.py \
  --checkpoint checkpoints/r3live/best.pt \
  --output /root/autodl-fs/models/semantic_gaussian_prior/r3live_distilled.ts
```

For the controlled v4 comparison, run all fixed training strategies with:

```bash
PRIOR_MANIFEST=/path/to/context_v4/manifest.json \
PRIOR_INIT_CHECKPOINT=/path/to/v3/best.pt \
PRIOR_OUTPUT_ROOT=/path/to/v4/checkpoints \
bash scripts/run_context_prior_training.sh
```

Run the online student with:

```bash
SEMANTIC_GAUSSIAN_PRIOR_MODEL=/root/autodl-fs/models/semantic_gaussian_prior/r3live_distilled.ts \
SEMANTIC_GAUSSIAN_PRIOR_INPUT_DIM=38 \
SEMANTIC_GAUSSIAN_PRIOR_CONTEXT_GAIN=0.5 \
SEMANTIC_GAUSSIAN_PRIOR_EXACT_SPACING=false \
SEMANTIC_GAUSSIAN_PRIOR_LIGHTWEIGHT_CONTEXT=true \
SEMANTIC_GAUSSIAN_PRIOR_MEAN_OFFSET_LIMIT=4.0 \
PRIOR_RESIDUAL_OPTIMIZATION_ITERS=20 \
bash scripts/run_full_object_memory_r3live.sh \
  prior_fold_test dynamic r3live_prior backend_contract all_dynamic 20260727 object
```

The frozen no-Prior baseline uses `r3live_paper`, not `r3live_prior`. Keep
`SEMANTIC_GAUSSIAN_PRIOR_INPUT_DIM=24` for a v3 model and `38` for v4; the C++
node performs a startup shape/finite probe and rejects mismatched models.

The v4 runtime controls are:

- `SEMANTIC_GAUSSIAN_PRIOR_CONTEXT_GAIN`: scales only columns 24-37 before
  inference; `0` exactly restores the v3 input path inside an expanded model.
- `SEMANTIC_GAUSSIAN_PRIOR_EXACT_SPACING`: disables the per-keyframe CUDA KNN
  spacing feature when false.
- `SEMANTIC_GAUSSIAN_PRIOR_LIGHTWEIGHT_CONTEXT`: avoids source-frame gradient
  transport. The filtered keyframe candidates assemble normalized pixel
  position, reliability, and uncovered fraction directly on the GPU while
  gradient and spacing columns remain zero.
- `SEMANTIC_GAUSSIAN_PRIOR_LOG_SCALE_LIMIT`: clips the deployed log-scale
  residual without changing the trained TorchScript file.

`random_seed` now seeds the C++ and CUDA generators. Skybox sampling and the
dynamic candidate keep mask are generated by the seeded C++ generator rather
than process-global CUDA RNG state. Custom CUDA rasterization still prevents
bit-identical PLY files, so paper tables must use at least three repeated runs
and report mean plus sample standard deviation.

The E022 frozen-input result did not establish a speed-quality advantage:
lightweight v4 at 20 residual steps improved mean novel-view PSNR by only about
0.06 dB while increasing backend compute by about 17%; at 10 steps it failed
to recover the 20-step baseline. Treat parameter-only Teacher distillation as
an ablation, not the final method. The next model must be selected with
rendering reconstruction or short-unroll supervision.
